research_notes: Follow-up: identify earlier agriculture/trade/banking and student employers; obtain Defence start and secondment/payroll record, Eurasia/Hawker dates and hours, SBS departure/full-time terms, and any post-SBS consultancy. Resolve VMC commission versus RAC endpoints and adjunct terms.

2026-09-29: searched APH/Defence biographies, SBS appointment and later employer profiles, Brookings announcement/publication/proceedings, VMC annual report, contemporary SBS inquiry record, ABC reporting, full-time terms and public professional profiles. Found useful primary dates but no adequate full-time interval evidence.

2026-09-29: Brookings July 2006 author page resolves three month-level spells. Secondary accounts suggesting a year at Brookings conflict with October 2004–May 2005 and are not used. October 2004 DFAT/fellowship boundary remains imprecise, so no simultaneous full-time claim.

2026-09-29: SBS annual-report/departure searches did not establish a precise exit or hours. ABC's November 2015 former-executive description and May 2015 committee appearance bound the departure within 2015. Generic immediately-before-parliament biographies must not silently extend SBS employment to July 2016.

2026-09-29: public LinkedIn result https://au.linkedin.com/in/pkhalil surfaced current activity without usable historical chronology. Full-time queries chiefly returned vacancies in his office, not evidence of his own past hours; those adverts were not used.

Pre-Defence work and possible later independent consultancy remain major gaps. Degrees or a generic lawyer label do not establish a legal-practice spell. Do not infer work continuity, calculate totals from senior titles, or sum overlapping secondments and adjunct appointments.

Follow-up2026-10-02: employer annual-report footnotes resolve SBS departure July2015. Own June2010 alumni contribution corroborates simultaneous Hawker Britton consultancy and Sydney adjunct role. No double counting or full-time inference.

Follow-up2026-10-03: contemporaneous sources now bracket Eurasia Group from8 July2005 through8 December2006 and support a February2007 Rudd-office start month. A May2008 dialogue programme observes the Defence-minister adviser role, and a register current29 October2009 independently confirms Hawker Britton affiliation. Point observations were not converted into exact appointment boundaries or full-time status.

Examined SBS2014–15 and2015–16 reports, appointment releases, university alumni profile, historical consultancy and departure searches. Crikey3 September2015 indexed departure lead pointed toward annual reports; restricted article not bypassed. Primary2014–15 report supplies stronger month evidence.

Next leads: exact SBS cessation/contract and leave, Eurasia and Hawker appointment/cessation/FTE records, exact2008 political-staff transition, pre-Defence employer identities and dates, post-July2015 consulting, VMC individual appointment/cessation. Defence commencement cannot be inferred from the alumni degree year.

2026-10-04 follow-up: a Brookings participant biography for the 18–20 February 2006 U.S.-Islamic World Forum independently observes current Eurasia Group employment and the sequence after Brookings. This does not narrow the already bracketed July 2005–December 2006 Eurasia interval or establish full-time hours. Targeted APH, SBS, Brookings and public professional-profile searches found no stronger Hawker Britton commencement, Defence start/secondment, post-SBS consultancy or FTE evidence. APH search access was blocked by robots.txt; the avenue and exact limitation are recorded rather than treated as zero evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added omitted university studies. Primary June2010 alumni magazine labels BA/LLB1997, which differs from derivative1996 graduation descriptions; retained primary qualification year without inventing attendance endpoints. ANU qualification dates remain unknown, and unlabeled professional-profile rows are not mapped to institutions. Government27 October2015 VMC appointment announcement corroborates governance but is not a commencement instrument. Web alumniPDF400 Timeout fetching was recovered through ordinary public PDF retrieval/text extraction; neighboring film/public-service career not assigned to Khalil. Employment hours, earlier employers, secondment and later gaps retained.

2026-10-05 new-lead follow-up: original John Curtin Research Centre Our People page separates its board and advisory council and lists Khalil in the latter; March2024 publisher governance index provides a contemporary advisory observation. Added omitted nonprofit advisory activity and publisher-attributed2017/2021 publication work, with unknown paid status, working dates and hours. No continuous term or2017–2021employment inferred. Original magazine PDF open Internal Error and ordinary download403 Forbidden are source-only failures; indexed contents/editorial used explicitly, with no bypass or claim to article inspection. FIRST UK trustee at AWS is a namesake and was rejected. Earlier employers, Defence/consultancy/SBS hours and personal payroll dates remain follow-up gaps; no totals calculated.

Second targeted primary-source pass: Hawker Britton appointment, Eurasia commencement, pre-Defence agriculture/banking employer and SBS full-time searches found existing appointment biographies or other peoples job advertisements. SBS Dinka July2016 episode description independently corroborates Hawker/consulting experience, but generic consulting wording does not establish a separate post-SBS employer or 2015–2016 paid interval; linked as corroboration only. Dinka-language page open Internal Error recovered through the English version. No title-derived FTE, degree-derived Defence start or continuous consultancy period imposed. Appointment, leave, payroll and earlier-employer gaps retained.
